about: High River is a town in southern Alberta on the Highwood River, south of Calgary in Foothills County ranch and farm country. A historic downtown, agricultural roots, and recovery from major Highwood floods shape civic identity. Highway 2 passes west of town toward Okotoks and Calgary. About 14,000 people live in High River.
